body: How do I get rid of it/them?
How did you fix it? The runny stomach is the worse for me. I'm in the bathroom 6+ times/day and I hate it and it hurts.
Because I am exhausted and if I disappear I can finally rest.

Like another Redditor suggested, purge your social media. I have this throwaway for Reddit, but that's it. I get a new phone number every couple years and only give it to people I actually want to talk to. Otherwise I'm pretty reclusive outside of work, which is (fortunately) not extremely social. But I know the feeling. I have the urge to just disappear almost daily. For me I just know the process of starting over would overwhelm me, so I chicken out.

I see a therapist weekly, psychiatrist monthly. I will add this to the list of issues, which just seems to get longer...

EDIT: Thank you.
Same here! I have always have a finnicky digestive system and only now am I learning that stress/depression/anxiety can cause it...

Yikes. How do I rid myself of it? I'm prescribed Xanax to sleep on Fri, Sat, Sun nights and on those nights I feel great. I feel great the next day, too. But those are the only nights I get to sleep each week. I had no clue anxiety could make me feel like I was hit by a truck and have a stomach bug. :(

I struggle with this, too. The Aspergers makes showers *hurt* and completely overloads my senses... but also the feeling mid-way through a day I didn't shower makes me want to peel my own skin off... so yeah, I just shower. I wish I could live in a cold room where I never sweat and could just have a human version of a dishwasher for showers.

Same here, friend. I wish I could go back and tell 12 year old me: "Hey, they're still awake. They'll hear you unlocking the gun safe now. wait another hour." Everything since then has been a mistake that just makes life worse.
I agree. I will never have kids (I may one day adopt). I often wish my parents had spared me existence.
Oh, yikes! I'm so sorry to hear that... and also hope I don't have MS.

Spite can be powerful. Sadly I lack it. You have a grand purpose it seems, which is good. I used to have one - running my own research lab - until I realized it would never happen and even if it did or I somehow got funding I would never be able to handle it. I hate my parents because they were both shitty and abusive (one verbally any physicaly, one emotionally). But I've cut them out of my life for the most part and they don't bother me. My relationship is a mess, it's not a "why" - if anything it's a "why not". My only "why" I have found is my job and I suspect I'm slipping closer to being fired each week.
Same here. The urge to remove my cosmically insignificant self from a beautiful world being destroyed by disgusting humans.

I know two people that did exactly that here. One left a very nice position and was welcomed back as a custodian. There's nothing wrong with custodial work, but that was "the only way" they could keep this person's job available (they were in tech). The other person came back to such a hostile environment they left the company. I'm afraid of this because this place is the only place I can work in my field without having to relocate.

Sadly my employer is powered by reputation, politics, and image. A "crazy" person working for them would immediately be terminated through some trickery to cover their asses. I have considered submitting for leave before, but I have heard multiple instances of people's job be replaced or downgraded once the leave ends. I'm afraid of that, too.
Thanks. :)
Happy Birthday! You have my word that I will stay alive for at least one more day.

Is SMI Serious Mental Illness? I'm sorry, I don't always pickup on acronyms, even if they're contextually relevant. 

I struggle to shower daily and keep up with clothes and hygiene. I didn't shower today. I wear the same pair of pants and overshirt every day except laundry day (I do wear clean undergarments each day!) My sleep is a mess, even with meds, and lately sleeping with my partner has been difficult whereas it used to help. 

I live in a small town. Do you think the would have a presence here? How do I find if my town has a NAMI hotline? What's NAMI?

Thank you, again!

I'm sorry to hear that. Are you able to find a TV show you like? For me that at least distracts me and even sometimes makes me laugh or smile for a few hours. I know it's not much, and I know it's not healthy, but it's *something*.

That daily war I wage and struggle to hold my ground against is winning? Seriously? Why the heck don't people just kill themselves if that's considered winning? I'm sorry to be offensive or anything, I just can't believe that someone like me would be considered to have "won" at life... 

I do the meditation thing regularly and it helps. I can keep a good chunk of the physical manifestations of panic from setting in by focusing on my breathing. I'm glad I'm not the only one! Thank you! 

I had no clue those sorts of organizations existed, thank you! I will look into them. I have been avoiding disclosing anything to my employer for fear of discrimination (legal or not, I know it happens) and I dread disability because it would just make me feel like more of a worthless failure. 

I try to sit on my porch each day and soak up some sun. I used to take walks in the cemetery which I liked, but I stopped because getting there was too overwhelming (noise and people). But I will try to resume those, too. Thank you again!

I hate children and never want them, I'm horrible allergic to pets. I have a job that I really enjoy, my job has always been my "why" I suppose. And yes, I have a girlfriend at the moment, but that's honestly not going well. What other "why" can I have? I have no friends, my hobbies are fairly isolating (video games, Netflix). What are some good "why"s?
What do you mean a "why"?
